Trend: Filter coffee bags versus supermarket coffee
Description: Tim Wendelboe and Supreme Roastworks (Sentrum/Grünerløkka), Kaffa (Oslo Øst), Den Gyldne Bønne (Bærum), Bergen Kaffebrenneri and Jacobsen og Svart (Trondheim) make retail bags a real dark-store SKU. List them in those catchments; keep a short set in Lørenskog. A first Tromsø store should not copy the full Oslo coffee wall.

Description: Lervig (Hillevåg/Stavanger), 7 Fjell (Bergen), Austmann (Trondheim) and Amundsen (Oslo) are the grocery craft alternatives to Ringnes/Frydenlund. Mack belongs on a Tromsø first-store list only — it is Tromsø beer, not an Oslo 'local' win. Cold-chain cans in those catchments; family stores stay on national beer.

Description: Åpent Bakeri (Oslo), VÅG (Damsgård/Bergen), Rosenkildehaven (Stavanger) and Hevd (Trondheim) made long-ferment loaves a grocery ask, not only a café plate. Short surdeig set in Sentrum, Bergen and Trondheim; daily bread stays the volume SKU in Lørenskog.

Description: Fenaknoken and Strøm-Larsen still beat supermarket spekeskinke. Delivery wins if Sentrum lists fenalår and spekemat as grocery rather than sending people to the counter. Keep it short in Lørenskog family baskets.
